items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: He'd play with Buddy P.T. and Baird Perez and Punch and Big Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: about that high. I'm a rick. sharky, he was riding. Sharky, he wasn't set about playing no sharky a long time before he started playing on. But when he did get a start at it, he just went right on through with it. He'd play with Buddy P.T. and Baird Perez and Punch and Big Joe Oliver. He'd just play with any one of them trucks would come along. The first one would come, he'd just jump on and go on with them fellas and go on and play.
Did you ever play one of those advertising jobs? Did they ever have a piano on the truck?
